components.name: Orchestrator

components.description: Core control instructions constraining the model behavior and output style.

components.description: Screens content for unsafe instructions and policy violations before deeper processing.

components.description: Registry of available tools and their callable schema contracts.

components.name: Output
components.description: Final response channel back to the user or calling surface.

components.name: LLM Reasoning / Planning
components.description: Model reasoning stage that interprets plan + context and decides the next action.

components.name: Execution (Call Tools)
components.description: Runtime execution layer where tools are called and results are returned.

components.name: Long-Term Memory Storage
components.description: Persistent memory store used across sessions.

components.name: Task Analysis
components.description: Evaluates task/tool intent for policy, risk, and escalation requirements.

components.name: Abort or HITL
components.description: Decision checkpoint where risky actions are either blocked or escalated to human review.

components.name: Planning Loop
components.description: Builds the task execution strategy and iterates until plan quality checks pass.

components.name: Task (Turn) Context
components.description: Holds immediate turn-specific context used for this request cycle.

components.name: Spotlighting
components.description: Isolation stage for suspicious prompt segments, especially potential XPIA patterns.

components.name: Prompt Editing
components.description: Sanitizes or rewrites unsafe prompt text before it reaches planning and execution.

components.name: RAG
components.description: Retrieval pipeline entry for grounding responses with external knowledge.

components.name: Data Store
components.description: Structured backing store used by retrieval and lookup operations.

components.name: Vector Database
components.description: Embedding index used for semantic retrieval during RAG.
